_metadata.datasetName: Synthetic Emerging Issue & False Alert Benchmark
_metadata.label: CONTROLLED_SYNTHETIC_EVALUATION_DATA
_metadata.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION DATA ONLY. Used for algorithmic verification under controlled conditions. Does not represent production field telemetry or commercial claims.

cases.name: Rapid Multi-Observation Surge (True Spike)
cases.rationale: High velocity burst: 6 observations in 12h vs baseline 0.5/day exceeds z-score threshold.

cases.name: Steady State Normal Operations (Negative Control)
cases.rationale: 2 observations in 24 hours exactly matches baseline mean of 2.0/day. Zero anomaly.

cases.name: Standard Poisson Stochastic Noise (False Alert Defense)
cases.rationale: 4 observations vs 3.0 baseline is well within 95% Poisson confidence interval; must NOT trigger false alert.

cases.name: Extreme Cross-Shift Outage Surge (Critical True Positive)
cases.rationale: Massive sudden burst of 8 reports in 4 hours on near-zero baseline. Mission critical alert.

cases.name: Insufficient Historical Baseline Guard (Safety Floor)
cases.rationale: Only 1 observation in 2 days. Framework must reject alert due to insufficient baseline.

cases.name: Low Single-Count Inconsequential Incident
cases.rationale: Single observation is below historical baseline average. Must not alert.

cases.name: Accelerating Perishable Cold-Chain Excursion (True Positive)
cases.rationale: 4 observations in 6 hours in Food Safety with near-zero baseline. Must trigger immediate alert.

cases.name: Zero-Activity Quiescent Baseline (Negative Control)
cases.rationale: Zero observations in recent window. Perfectly quiescent.
